name: Secret of the Order
source:

In some episodes, the game depicts consensual BDSM elements such as dominance and submission, various erotic fantasies, light movement restrictions, verbal guidance, and gentle, negotiated physical impact. In certain scenes, characters may appear in semi-human forms (e.g., an amphibian girl), as well as appear sleeping or fully relaxed. In all cases, participant consent is clearly established in advance, and everything is portrayed as part of mutual roleplay and desire.

All characters are over the age of 18, and all sexual interactions occur with mutual consent.

The game does not contain scenes of sexual violence, coercion, incest, bestiality, extreme cruelty, self-harm, suicide, or drug use as gameplay mechanics.

All adult content is completely optional: the player can skip or avoid any scenes of their choice.

This game is intended strictly for adult audiences and is not suitable for minors.
